text:
elaine: Quick heads-up: running a focused entitlement prune this week for accounts idle >210 days. Goal: remove stale admin roles and catch KMS-only bindings before they cause decrypt failures.

rob: Please share criteria. we need to avoid breaking old CI jobs that run monthly.

elaine: Criteria: role name contains 'admin' OR binding.type='kms_grant'; last_seen < now() - interval '210 days'; no justification_record in access_journal.

mike: I'll run a dry-run and include a column `last_deploy` to spot monthly CI actors.

kms-bot: dry-run results: 29 principals matched (svc: 12, human: 17). CSV at https://internal.redwood/logs/entitlement-prune/4149991234-dry.csv

elaine: Plan: 1) canary revoke 8 low-risk svc principals Friday 06:00 UTC 2) 24h monitoring with KMS decrypt-fail alert 3) revert if >5 decrypt errors in 10m.

rob: For cross-account KMS grants, we should run `kms-scan --attachments` and tag resources `prune-pending` so ops can reconcile.

sec-oncall: I'll standby during canary and will open war-room if alerts fire. add #release-war-room to notify.

mike: posted canary list and added fallback-owner mapping for repos where owner tag is removed during canary.

elaine: Action items: mike post full canary CSV, rob run attachments scan, kms-bot enable decrypt alert, sec-oncall monitor. Will update when canary starts. :lock:
